elements.name: pale gravel road winding along steep mountainsides
tiny country bus on the road
long plume of dust trailing the bus
dense dark green juniper and eucalyptus forest
layered mountains fading into blue haze

wrong_setting: The trees are uniform pines rather than juniper and eucalyptus, which makes the scene read as the American West or the Mediterranean rather than the Ethiopian highlands. The vehicle is a small camper-style van rather than a country bus.
notes: Repaint the slopes with eucalyptus stands and juniper instead of generic pines, and make the vehicle a boxy, longer country bus so the scene reads as the Ethiopian highlands.
